title: Jewel Toned Algerian Beets Tagine
description: A comforting and resinous Algerian dish featuring beets, this tagine is a perfect blend of flavors and textures, with the added benefit of being Whole30 friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chopped beets, ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine or Dutch oven, and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the beets are tender.
Use a slotted spoon to transfer the beets to an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Let the beets cool in the ice bath, then drain and set them aside.
Continue to simmer the cooking liquid for an additional 10 minutes, or until it has thickened slightly.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve the tagine over the cooled beets.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
